requirements.evidence: Finding 1 (vacuous latest-user-message oracle) is REPAIRED: the suite now requires the drivers' literal follow-up bubble to be OBSERVED in the committed streams (bubbles >= 1 fails closed; present 1/18/24/24) and counts first-nonce occurrences in its visible text (live-example-proof.test.ts:351-360); the synthesizer mirrors over samples+finalTexts for future runs (live-example-proof.ts:2347-2353). prior_exchange_count is de-constant-ed in the synthesizer (derived from the session's gen-0 completed records). But finding 2 (non-discriminating recall) is only HALF repaired. I replicated the shipped oracle exactly (ANSWER_LEAD/ENGINE_TAG at live-example-proof.test.ts:333-336) and ran a disconnected-recall negative (strip every follow-up-answer phrasing — 'asked me to remember' / '(gave|give|aave) me the marker' / 'marker you/vou gave/aave' — from all samples, leaving everything else): nativewind-ios 23->0 and nativewind-android 17->0 (genuinely discriminating, and all their hits are positioned after the 'What marker' bubble in the same sample), but uniwind-ios 5->5 and uniwind-android 42->30 — BOTH STILL PASS WITH ZERO FOLLOW-UP RECALL. The surviving false-pass path is the 'with identifier' / 'identifier you provided' ANSWER_LEAD alternatives, which match marker-echo answers of turns whose PROMPTS contained the marker: uniwind-ios passes solely on 'ORI-RN-004 with identifier ORI-' lines (13:14:08-13:15:58, a marker-acknowledgment answer of a later turn) while its GENUINE follow-up recall at 13:16:03 ('You asked me to remember the marker ORI-' + wrapped continuation 'RN-004:0RI-AI-002-1790254489381-') FAILS the shipped ENGINE_TAG — the continuation line starts past the 'ORI-' wrap and /OR[I1l|][^\w]{0,2}RN/ does not match it. So on uniwind-ios the oracle passes for the wrong reason and misses the right evidence. Additionally, the implementer's claim that 'the first same-line-only draft genuinely FAILED against uniwind-ios' is documented nowhere (cycle-7 contains only green/README.md + gate logs, no red/ or draft artifact) and is not reproducible: the same-line variant of the SHIPPED regexes passes all four streams (5/42/23/17 hits).
requirements.fix: Two one-line changes to ANSWER_LEAD/ENGINE_TAG in BOTH live-example-proof.test.ts (~333) and live-example-proof.ts (~2333): (1) drop the 'identifier (you )?(provided|is)' and 'with identifier' alternatives — keep only '(gave|give) me the marker|asked me to remember|marker (you|vou) (gave|aave)' (phrasings that respond to the follow-up question and cannot come from a turn whose prompt contained the marker); (2) make ENGINE_TAG wrap-tolerant: /OR[I1l|][^\w]{0,2}RN|\bRN[-:]?\d/i (the added alternative matches the wrapped continuation line 'RN-004:0RI-...'). I verified this exact oracle against the four committed streams: real hits 1/12/23/17 (uniwind-ios's single hit IS its genuine 13:16:03 follow-up recall) and the disconnected-recall negative drops ALL FOUR to 0 — discriminating everywhere, still passing the real evidence. No engine re-run needed.
